info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Collateral Management API
info.description: The Collateral Management API enables financial institutions to efficiently manage and administer collateral collections. By facilitating the process of securing assets, this API allows for the seamless submission and tracking of collections related to banking operations. It is particularly useful for users involved in risk management and asset management, ensuring that collateral is adequately managed to mitigate financial risks. Leverage this API to streamline collateral collection processes and enhance operational efficiency in your banking services.

post.summary: Create a new collection in collateral administration.
post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create a new collection within the collateral administration system. It expects the necessary data for the collection in the request body. Successful creation will return the details of the newly created collection.
